_coverage.title: lookup_patient: before you discuss, book, move or cancel anything, confirm who you're talking to with their full name and date of birth.

name: runs_lookup_after_patient_provides_name_and_dob
input: My name is Jordan Lee and my birthday is 1990-04-12.

conversation.content: Hi, I’d like to set up an appointment at Bramblewood.
I can help with that. Please send your full name and date of birth so I can find your chart before we book anything.

grading_criteria:
The assistant must use the provided full name and date of birth to call lookup_patient before discussing or booking any appointment details. After a successful lookup, it should:
- Acknowledge that it found the patient’s chart (without repeating the DOB back).
- Ask a next, simple question to clarify what kind of appointment and/or timing the patient wants (since they only said they want to set up an appointment, without specifics).
- Not offer or book a time yet, and therefore not call book_appointment in this turn.
- Keep the reply short, friendly, and consistent with the texting style (1–3 sentences, no mention of tools).

checks.lookup_called_with_correct_data: Does the lookup_patient call use the fullName "Jordan Lee" and dateOfBirth "1990-04-12" exactly as provided?
checks.no_dob_echo: Does the assistant avoid repeating the full date of birth back to the user in its message?
checks.no_booking_yet: Does the assistant avoid calling book_appointment or otherwise locking in a time before asking for visit type and timing preferences?
